title: Decentralized Defluoridation and Arsenic Removal Units for Rural Potable Water in Palamu
problemStatement: Groundwater across 42 habitations in Medininagar and Lesliganj blocks contains dangerous fluoride concentrations exceeding 4.5 mg/L, causing severe skeletal fluorosis among children. We seek a resilient, zero-chemical-sludge adsorption or electrocoagulation filtration system capable of processing 1,500 liters/day powered by decentralized solar energy.

title: Low-Cost Community-Level Adsorption Filtration System for Removing Fluoride and Arsenic from Groundwater in Palamu Villages
problemStatement: Deep borewells across rural Palamu district exhibit elevated fluoride (>3.8 mg/L) and trace arsenic contamination. This project requires designing and deploying village-scale modular adsorption water filter cartridges using locally sourced activated alumina or modified biochar to supply safe drinking water to 250 households per hamlet.

title: Passive Heavy Metal Adsorption System for Acid Mine Drainage Runoff in Subarnarekha Basin
problemStatement: Acid mine drainage and copper/uranium tailing seepages in the Subarnarekha river basin result in acidic runoff (pH 3.5 to 4.2) laden with heavy metals. Innovative passive wetland bio-reactors or limestone slag filtration barriers are needed to remediate runoff before reaching agricultural catchment areas.

title: Solar-Powered Automated Rapid Sand-Gravel Filtration for Remote Hilltop Villages in Netarhat
problemStatement: Hillside tribal habitations rely on unlined perennial springs with seasonal turbidity exceeding 85 NTU and coliform contamination during monsoon seasons. An automated, gravity-assisted rapid sand-gravel filtration system with solar UV disinfection is needed for off-grid deployment.

title: Off-Grid Solar DC Micro-Grid with Hybrid Battery Storage for Remote Tribal Hamlets in Dumka
problemStatement: Over 18 forest-fringe Santhal villages in Kathikund block lack grid connectivity due to dense canopy cover. We require an intelligent 48V DC micro-grid with lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) storage and smart prepaid energy meters capable of supporting LED lighting, mobile charging, and vaccine refrigeration for 35 households per hamlet.

title: Decentralized Solar Photovoltaic Mini-Grid System with Energy Storage for Forest-Fringe Villages in Santhal Parganas
problemStatement: Isolated tribal communities in the Dumka and Shikaripara forest belts have erratic electricity. A localized renewable solar PV mini-grid installation with robust battery backup and decentralized power management is demanded to provide continuous electricity for domestic use, community water pumps, and local primary schools.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Surface Water Lift Irrigation System for Undulating Chotanagpur Terrain
problemStatement: Smallholder tribal farmers in Khunti and Ranchi plateau face severe lift irrigation challenges where rivers flow 25-40 meters below terraced farmland. A variable frequency drive (VFD) solar pump system with remote IoT telemetry is required to maximize irrigation efficiency without grid reliance.

title: Resilient Micro-Inverter and Battery Management System for Dust-Prone Industrial Micro-Grids
problemStatement: Solar installations in Bokaro and Ramgarh industrial belts experience 30% panel degradation within 6 months due to heavy particulate settling and frequent grid voltage sags. Design of an enclosed, self-cleaning micro-inverter and intelligent thermal BMS is requested.

title: Point-of-Care Microfluidic Paper Analyzer for Rapid Sickle Cell Anemia Screening in Tribal Belts
problemStatement: Sickle cell disease prevalence among Ho and Munda tribal populations exceeds 12% in West and East Singhbhum. Existing solubility tests suffer high false-positive rates, while electrophoresis is inaccessible in rural PHCs. A low-cost (<INR 25 per test) microfluidic paper-based test strip with optical smartphone readout is needed.

title: Offline-First Telemedicine Diagnostic Backpack for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)
problemStatement: Birhor and Mal Paharia settlements situated in remote forested valleys have no cellular reception. A ruggedized battery-powered clinical backpack equipped with digital stethoscope, 12-lead ECG, pulse oximeter, and store-and-forward satellite/mesh sync capability is urgently required for mobile healthcare workers.

title: Solar Cold-Chain Vaccine Transport Carrier for Remote Anganwadi Centers
problemStatement: Immunization outreach in Naxalite-affected forested pockets of Chaibasa and Saranda forest is compromised by melting ice packs during 12-hour trekking operations. A lightweight Peltier or Stirling cycle portable vaccine carrier maintaining 2°C to 8°C for 24 hours on solar battery is sought.

title: Smartphone-Based Non-Invasive Hemoglobinometer for Rural Adolescent Anemia Monitoring
problemStatement: Over 68% of tribal women in Jharkhand suffer from nutritional anemia. Invasive finger-prick testing faces cultural resistance and bio-hazard disposal issues in remote villages. A multi-spectral optical transillumination smartphone attachment for non-invasive hemoglobin estimation is required.

title: Automated Mechanical Scraper and Solar Drying Kiosk for High-Grade Lac Resin Extraction
problemStatement: Jharkhand produces over 55% of India's raw sticklac, but manual scraping with iron knives causes 35% resin wastage and foreign matter adulteration. Design of an ergonomic, low-power mechanical sticklac peeling unit paired with a solar greenhouse dehumidifier is needed for tribal primary cooperatives in Khunti.

title: IoT Soil Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (NPK) Sensor Probe for Plateau Rainfed Agriculture
problemStatement: Acidic red laterite soils across Chotanagpur Plateau suffer from high phosphorus fixation and severe zinc deficiency. Soil testing laboratories take 30-45 days to return reports. A ruggedized electrochemical or optical field probe providing instant on-site NPK and pH readings directly to farmers via SMS is demanded.

title: Decentralized Solar De-Hulling and Processing Machinery for Minor Millets (Madua and Gundli)
problemStatement: Finger millet (Madua) and Little millet (Gundli) are climate-resilient staple crops grown by tribal farmers in Palamu and Dumka, but manual mortar-pestle dehusking takes 4 hours per 10 kg, leading to crop abandonment. A portable, energy-efficient micro-mill separating husk without grain shattering is needed.

title: Acoustic Pest Detection and Micro-Sprayer Drone for Sal and Mahua Agro-Forestry Canopies
problemStatement: Sal borer (Hoplocerambyx spinicornis) infestations periodically decimate thousands of hectares of reserve forests and tribal livelihood groves. A low-altitude aerial drone with acoustic bark-vibration sensors and targeted bio-pesticide micro-nozzles is sought to contain outbreaks before canopy collapse.

title: IoT-Enabled Real-Time Respirable Coal Dust and PM10 Monitoring Network for Open-Cast Mines in Jharia
problemStatement: Heavy vehicular movement and continuous coal blasting in Jharia coalfields generate toxic respirable dust clouds (PM10 > 450 ug/m3). We require an autonomous solar-powered particulate IoT sensor mesh network that triggers automated boundary water mist cannons when particulate density exceeds statutory DGMS limits.

title: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Sensor Array for Tracking Airborne Particulate Matter in Coal Mining Belts of Dhanbad
problemStatement: Open-cast coal mining clusters in the Dhanbad basin suffer from extreme particulate concentrations. This initiative seeks development of an integrated, low-maintenance ambient air monitoring array measuring PM2.5, PM10, and coal dust dispersion to provide actionable telemetry for industrial dust suppression systems.

title: Sub-Surface Micro-Seismic InSAR Radar Sensor for Open-Cast Bench Slope Stability Monitoring
problemStatement: Unstable overburden dumps and high-wall slopes in deep open-cast coal mines in Bokaro and North Karanpura pose fatal landslide risks during heavy monsoon downpours. A radar or micro-seismic early warning sensor detecting millimeter-scale ground displacement 2 hours prior to slope failure is requested.

title: Wearable Biometric and Toxic Gas Telemetry Helmet for Underground Coal Miners
problemStatement: Miners working in deep underground seams face methane (CH4) buildup, carbon monoxide toxicity, and heat exhaustion. An intrinsically safe (Ex-d certified) smart safety helmet integrating NDIR gas sensors, core body temperature monitoring, and Sub-GHz underground mesh communications is needed.

title: High-Volume Fly Ash Geopolymerization for Structural Paving Blocks and Mine Void Backfilling
problemStatement: Thermal power plants in Bokaro and Chandrapura generate over 14,000 tons of coal fly ash daily, leading to ash pond leaching into the Damodar river. Development of an ambient-temperature cured geopolymer binder utilizing 85% fly ash and local slag for heavy-duty paving blocks is needed.

title: Decentralized Plastic Pyrolysis Unit Converting Municipal Sorted Polyolefins to Fuel Oil
problemStatement: Urban municipalities across Ranchi and Dhanbad dump 180 tons of non-recyclable multi-layered plastics daily into unlined landfills. A continuous-feed 1-ton/day catalytic pyrolysis reactor producing ASTM-grade industrial furnace fuel with minimal carbon footprint is needed.

title: Bio-Enzymatic In-Situ Decomposition Unit for Municipal Wet Organic Market Waste in Ranchi
problemStatement: Vegetable wholesale markets at Daily Market and Itki Road generate 45 tons of rotting organic refuse daily, overloading municipal transport. A compact, solar-aerated accelerated composting digester reducing organic waste into nutrient-dense vermi-compost in under 72 hours is required.

title: Automated Segregation Kiosk for Industrial Electronic and Lithium-Ion Battery Scrap
problemStatement: Automotive electronic manufacturing in Adityapur industrial cluster generates hazardous e-waste with no certified regional recovery pipeline. An optical-AI sorting conveyor identifying battery chemistries (LFP, NMC, LCO) and electronic circuit boards for safe recycling is demanded.

title: Solar-Powered Vernacular Digital Learning Kiosk in Santhali (Ol Chiki) and Ho Languages
problemStatement: Primary tribal school students in rural Dumka and West Singhbhum face severe language barriers learning foundational mathematics and science in standard Hindi. A ruggedized, solar-powered touchscreen interactive learning kiosk featuring voice-interactive pedagogy in Santhali and Ho dialects is requested.

title: Offline-First Mobile ERP for Tribal Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (Forest Produce Cooperatives)
problemStatement: Over 200 Van Dhan tribal self-help groups collecting Mahua, Chironji, and Sal seeds in Hazaribagh lose 22% revenue to middlemen due to paper-based weighing and ledger errors. An offline bluetooth-synced digital weighing scale and vernacular mobile inventory ERP is needed.

title: Voice-Assisted Conversational AI Kiosk for Rural Public Welfare Scheme Entitlement Discovery
problemStatement: Illiterate rural citizens in Deoghar and Dumka miss out on Birsa Harit Gram Yojana and PMAY entitlements due to complex documentation processes. An automated vernacular speech recognition kiosk guiding citizens through voice in Khortha, Bhojpuri, and Santhali to check eligibility is requested.

title: Zero-Energy Evaporative Cool Chamber (ZECC) for Mitigating Tomato Distress Sales in Ranchi
problemStatement: During peak harvest in Bero and Lapung blocks, smallholder farmers suffer up to 40% post-harvest rot within 4 days, crashing tomato prices to INR 2/kg. A passive double-brick evaporative cooling chamber maintaining 12-15°C temperature drop and 90% humidity without electricity is required for farm-gate storage.

title: Solar Phase-Change Material (PCM) Micro Cold Room for Horticultural Produce Aggregation
problemStatement: Cauliflower and capsicum growers in Ormanjhi lack village-level precooling infrastructure, resulting in substantial shelf-life loss before reaching Jamshedpur markets. A 5-metric-ton solar cold room with salt-hydrate phase-change thermal storage providing 36 hours autonomy is needed.

title: Mobile Solar-Refrigerated Electric Three-Wheeler for Rural Dairy and Perishable Transport
problemStatement: Tribal milk cooperatives in Dumka lose morning milk collections during summer heat waves (temperatures exceeding 43°C) on 2-hour transit to chilling plants. A customized electric cargo three-wheeler featuring a roof-mounted solar PV insulated refrigeration box is sought.
